items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I never heard Buddy Petito. ... [INTERVIEWEE] But never got the hearing, though.

ctx.x: No, I didn't know what the mouthpiece he had. I never used it. And what else I took and done? That time, like, Buddy, I used to let you get Buddy and Kid Rene get together.

You would, didn't you see any of those? I heard Kid Rene. I never heard Buddy Petito. Buddy was tough, man. I never got together. Oh. Now, Buddy, you ever heard Chris Kelly? Oh, never heard him. I've heard of him a lot.

But never got the hearing, though. They played. Man, I used to like to hear that man playing Going Back to Jamaica. He had one of those short... My cousin was playing with him, didn't he? This wasn't a great picture. Playing Going Back to Jamaica. Man, that man could make the horn talk. Going like... You know who's playing Trammaw with him? Earl Humphrey's brother. See Earl Humphrey's brother? Poison's brother? You know Poison Humphrey? Yeah. And the Relay. Yeah. What I'm talking about Willie? He's brother one of…
